# Heatmap
```{r}
dataH <- read.csv(file = here::here("data", "PHOTO-2022-06-10-04-10-59.csv"), check.names = FALSE)

dataH <- dataH[-2,-which(names(dataH) %in% c("Annotation","Accession #","NS Probe ID","Class Name","Analyte Type","% Samples above Threshold"))]

rownames(dataH) <- dataH$`Probe Name`

dataH <- dataH[,-which(names(dataH) %in% c("Probe Name"))]
```

# Fig 4A
```{r,fig.height=13,fig.width=12}
dataT <- dataH

samplecondition <- data.frame (t(dataT[1,]))

samplecondition$samplename <- rownames(samplecondition)

samplecondition[,1] <- factor(samplecondition[,1], levels = c("HC","EN", "EI"))

samplecondition <- samplecondition[order(samplecondition[,1]),]

dataT<- dataT[samplecondition$samplename]

temp <- dataT[2:610,]

temp <- mutate_all(temp, function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))


#sign <- ttest %>% head(n=40) %>%pull(Assay)
#plot_sig <- temp %>% filter(row.names(temp) %in% sign) %>% as.matrix()

gene_order <- c("TYK2","TRAF5","ZAP70","RUNX1","NOD1","IL1R1","CCL19","NFKB2","TICAM1","IL1B","RELB","RELA","TRAF4","IRAK1","CD14","TLR4","TLR1","TLR8","TLR2","TNFRSF1B","TNFRSF14","TRAF3","TRAF1","IRF5","STAT1","MYD88","ICAM1","CD40","TNF","CCL4","LTA","BCL2","ATM","TGFB1","TRAF2","TNFRSF4","TNFRSF8","TIRAP","TNFRSF10C","BCL10","NFKBIA","TNFAIP3","TLR3")
plot_sig <- temp %>% filter(row.names(temp) %in% gene_order) %>% as.matrix()
plot_sig <- plot_sig[gene_order[gene_order %in% rownames(plot_sig)], , drop = FALSE]


plot_scale <- t(scale(t(plot_sig)))

anno_group <- data.frame (t(dataT[1,]))[,1]

metadata <- read_excel(here::here("data", "ClinicalMetadata.xlsx"))
anno_idiopathic <- metadata$Idiopathic[match(colnames(dataT), metadata$Name)]

column_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(Condition = anno_group,
                               Idiopathic = anno_idiopathic,
                               col = list(Condition = c("HC" = "#ffc700","EI" = "#fe2504","EN" = "#01c7e1"),
                                          Idiopathic = c("HC" = "#ffc700","Idiopathic" = "#e05c00","Not Idiopathic" = "#c8c8c8")),
                               border = TRUE,annotation_name_gp= gpar(fontsize = 3),
                               annotation_legend_param = list(direction = "horizontal",title = "Condition",
                                                              title_gp = gpar(fontsize= 15),
                                                              labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 15)))

 
heat_group <- Heatmap(plot_scale,
                      name = " ",
                      top_annotation = column_ha,
                      row_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 15),cluster_rows = FALSE,
                      column_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 10),
                      column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 15),
                      row_title = NULL,
                      column_split = factor(rep(c("HC","EN","EI"),c(9,16,16)),levels = c("HC","EN","EI")),
                      cluster_column_slices = FALSE,
                      show_column_names = TRUE)
heat_group

```


# Fig 4B
```{r}
data <- read.csv(file = here::here("data", "PHOTO-2022-06-10-04-10-59.jpg.csv"), check.names = FALSE)

colnames(data)

colnames(data)[8:48] <- sapply(as.vector(colnames(data[8:48])),function(x){strsplit(x,"_",)[[1]][3]})

data <- data[-c(2),-c(2:7) ]

for (i in c("TLR2","TLR4","IRAK1","CCL2","RELA","NFKBIA")) {

dratiodf <- melt(data[data$`Probe Name` %in% c(i),],id.vars = "Probe Name",variable.name = "Type",value.name = "Value")
    
dratiodf$Group <- toupper(stringr::str_extract(dratiodf$Type, "^.{2}"))
    
dratiodf$Value <- as.integer(dratiodf$Value)
    
dratiodf$Group <- as.factor(dratiodf$Group)
    
dratiodf$Group <- factor(dratiodf$Group,c("BS","EN","EI"))
    
dratiodf$Group <- revalue(dratiodf$Group,c("BS"="HC","EN","EI"))
    
p <- ggboxplot(dratiodf, x = "Group", y = "Value" ,group_by="Group", fill = "Group",main = i, xlab = "", ylab = "Normalized Counts" ,
        palette = c("HC" = "#FFC700","EN" = "#01C7E1","EI" = "#FE2504"))+
        #           stat_compare_means(method ="anova",label.y = 150)+
        stat_compare_means(label = "p.signif", method = "t.test",ref.group = ".all.")+
        geom_hline(yintercept = mean(dratiodf[,c(3)]), linetype = 2)+
        theme(text = element_text(size = 20))+  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))+
        theme(legend.position="right")

print(p)
}
```

# Fig 4B check significant genes box plots
```{r}
DEEN <- read.csv(file = here::here("data", "DE results - TypeEN.csv"))
DEEI <- read.csv(file = here::here("data", "DE results - TypeEI.csv"))

genes_box <- c("TLR2","TLR4","IRAK1","CCL2","RELA","NFKBIA")

pval_stars <- function(p) ifelse(is.na(p), "not found",
                          ifelse(p <= 0.001, "***",
                          ifelse(p <= 0.01,  "**",
                          ifelse(p <= 0.05,  "*", "ns"))))

sig_check <- data.frame(
  Gene     = genes_box,
  pval_EN  = DEEN$BY.p.value[match(genes_box, DEEN$gene)],
  pval_EI  = DEEI$BY.p.value[match(genes_box, DEEI$gene)]
)
sig_check$stars_EN <- pval_stars(sig_check$pval_EN)
sig_check$stars_EI <- pval_stars(sig_check$pval_EI)

print(sig_check)
```

# Fig 5B check significant genes box plots DE for IFNG, IL4, IL5, IL3 (for not found)
```{r}
genes_de_extra <- c("IFNG", "IL4", "IL5", "IL3","IL6")

condition_vec <- as.character(unlist(dataH[1, ]))
names(condition_vec) <- colnames(dataH)

all_genes <- rownames(dataH)[2:nrow(dataH)]

run_de <- function(genes_of_interest, group1, group2) {
  all_results <- lapply(all_genes, function(g) {
    expr <- as.numeric(dataH[g, ])
    g1 <- expr[condition_vec == group1]
    g2 <- expr[condition_vec == group2]
    tt <- tryCatch(t.test(g1, g2), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(tt)) return(data.frame(Gene=g, log2FC=NA, p.value=NA))
    data.frame(Gene   = g,
               log2FC = log2(mean(g1, na.rm=TRUE) / mean(g2, na.rm=TRUE)),
               p.value = tt$p.value)
  })
  df <- do.call(rbind, all_results)
  df$BY.p.value  <- p.adjust(df$p.value, method = "BY")
  df$stars       <- pval_stars(df$BY.p.value)
  df$comparison  <- paste0(group1, " vs ", group2)
  df[df$Gene %in% genes_of_interest, c("Gene","comparison","log2FC","p.value","BY.p.value","stars")]
}

de_EN <- run_de(genes_de_extra, "EN", "HC")
de_EI <- run_de(genes_de_extra, "EI", "HC")

cat("EN vs HC:\n");   print(de_EN)
cat("\nEI vs HC:\n"); print(de_EI)
```

# Supplementary Fig 2A
```{r,fig.height=9,fig.width=10}
dataAI <- dataH

dataAI[1,] <- metadata$Idiopathic[match(metadata$Name, names(dataAI[1,]))]

samplecondition <- data.frame (t(dataAI[1,]))

samplecondition$samplename <- rownames(samplecondition)

samplecondition[,1] <- factor(samplecondition[,1], levels = c("Idiopathic", "Not Idiopathic","HC"))

samplecondition <- samplecondition[order(samplecondition[,1]),]

dataAI<- dataAI[samplecondition$samplename]

temp <- dataAI[2:610,]

temp <- mutate_all(temp, function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))


idio_samples <- samplecondition$samplename[samplecondition[,1] == "Idiopathic" & !is.na(samplecondition[,1])]
not_idio_samples <- samplecondition$samplename[samplecondition[,1] == "Not Idiopathic" & !is.na(samplecondition[,1])]
de_pvals <- apply(temp, 1, function(gene_expr) {
  tryCatch(
    t.test(gene_expr[idio_samples], gene_expr[not_idio_samples])$p.value,
    error = function(e) NA
  )
})
sign <- names(sort(de_pvals, na.last = TRUE))[1:24]
plot_sig <- temp %>% filter(row.names(temp) %in% sign) %>% as.matrix()

#plot_sig <- temp %>% filter(row.names(temp) %in% c("ABCB1","ABL1","ADA","AHR","AICDA","AIRE","APP","ARG1","ARG2","ARHGDIB","ATG10","ATG12","ATG16L1","ATG5","ATG7"  ,"ATM","B2M","B3GAT1","BATF","BATF3","BAX","BCAP31","BCL10","BCL2","BCL2L11","BCL3","BCL6","BID","BLNK","BST1","BST2","BTK","BTLA","C14orf166","C1QA","C1QB","C1QBP","C1R","C1S","C2")) %>% as.matrix()


plot_scale <- t(scale(t(plot_sig)))

anno_group <- data.frame (t(dataAI[1,]))[,1]

column_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(Condition = anno_group,
                               col = list(Condition = c("Idiopathic" = "#e05c00","HC" = "#ffc700","Not Idiopathic" = "#c8c8c8")),
                               border = TRUE,annotation_name_gp= gpar(fontsize = 3),
                               annotation_legend_param = list(direction = "horizontal",title = "Condition",
                                                              title_gp = gpar(fontsize= 15),
                                                              labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 15)))

heat_group <- Heatmap(plot_scale,
                      name = " ",
                      top_annotation = column_ha,
                      row_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 15),
                      column_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 10),
                      column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 15),
                      row_title = NULL,
                      column_split = factor(rep(c("Idiopathic", "Not Idiopathic","HC"),c(15,17,9)),levels = c("Idiopathic", "Not Idiopathic","HC")),
                      cluster_column_slices = FALSE,
                      show_column_names = TRUE)
heat_group


```
